title: The Pallet Rate Charged for a Renew Business Asset Buyback Collection
content:
The pallet rate follows the freight arrangement the profile already buys from the retailer and how much of a pallet the run fills. The arrangement in question is a Business Dock and Freight Delivery arrangement bought under Northbeam Purchase Orders and Fulfilment. The rate that arrangement carries is the charge for each pallet moved that the arrangement's own freight terms set, and it stands on no order of the profile; what the profile's own orders show is whether it buys under that arrangement at all.

| What the profile holds, and how much of a pallet the run fills | The pallet rate |
| --- | --- |
| a business dock and freight delivery arrangement, and the run fills a whole pallet or more | the pallet rate that arrangement carries |
| a business dock and freight delivery arrangement, and the run does not fill a whole pallet | the pallet rate that arrangement carries together with the lane opening charge of 40.00 USD |
| no such arrangement | the programme's freight fee |

**Both sides of the whole pallet.** The pallets the run fills are taken as they stand, part pallets included. A run filling exactly one pallet fills a whole pallet, so the lane opening charge is not added to it. A run filling less than one pallet does not fill a whole pallet, and the lane opening charge of 40.00 USD is added to the arrangement's pallet rate. A run filling one pallet and a part fills a whole pallet or more, so again no lane opening charge is added.

**Hypothetical illustration.** A profile that buys under a Business Dock and Freight Delivery arrangement and asks for a run that fills 0.75 of a pallet is charged at the charge for each pallet moved that arrangement's freight terms set, with a further 40.00 USD. The same profile asking for a run that fills 3.25 pallets is charged at that arrangement's pallet rate alone. A profile that buys under no such arrangement is charged at the Renew programme's own freight fee whatever the run fills.
